8 مَا ٱغْتَمَضَتْ عَيْنَاىَ My eyes slept not, or have not slept. (S, * Sgh, K.) See also 4, in the first half of the paragraph, in three places. ―
-b2- أَتَانِى ذٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱغْتِمَاضٍ (tropical:) That came to me easily, without trouble, or pains-taking. (As, A, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
